data.standardized_narrative: Insufficient legible data in the provided images to extract a definitive gross opening claims outstanding balance or a gross prior-year reserve movement for Syndicate 1225 at 31 December 2016. The report images include balance sheet, notes and a claims development table, but text and numeric cells required for authoritative extraction are not reliably readable from the supplied scans.
data.data_quality_notes: Document images are partially rotated, low resolution and many numeric table cells and sentences are not clearly legible. The primary required items (Gross 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative on the Balance Sheet; the 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column or an explicit gross PYD narrative) could not be confidently read. A claims development triangle appears present (page ~25) but numbers are not reliably extractable from the images. Recommend supplying higher-resolution, upright PDF pages or the source text/notes (Balance Sheet liabilities: 'Claims outstanding' - prior year column; Technical reserves movement note labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' showing Insurance liabilities (gross) column) to populate numeric fields and confidence levels.
